integrity: Proof derives first and second moments using two separate exact finite-state transfers; finite brute-force enumeration tests the formulas but not infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric stationary two-state Markov hole selector; only binary cylinders 00 and 11, not arbitrary holes.
Moments over environmental paths with common environment for all initial points; no quenched almost-sure escape exponent established.
No claim of complete historical priority or independent validation.
title: Exact second-moment escape amplification for Markov-switched dyadic holes
